3. Texture Anomaly (Severity 2): The metal shield pattern is smudged. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted 'slight blur' (0.2 severity), which aligns with the Router's observation of indistinct embossing.

The severity of the structural collapse remains high (4) because the fusion creates a non-functional, nonsensical object.
